documentId.description: The ID of the document to read, found in its URL: 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit'. Obtain it from Search Documents or Find Document if you only have a name.

replace_all_text.label: Replace All Text in Document

documentId.description: The ID of the document to edit, found in its URL: 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit'.

replace_all_text.beforeRequest:

search_documents.label: Search Documents
search_documents.description: Search Google Drive for Google Docs documents by name or full-text content.

name_contains.label: Name Contains
name_contains.description: Return documents whose name contains this text. Provide this and/or Content Contains.

full_text_contains.label: Content Contains
full_text_contains.description: Return documents whose full text content contains this text. Provide this and/or Name Contains.

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of documents to return (1-100).

page_token.label: Page Token
page_token.description: Token for the next page of results, taken from the nextPageToken of a previous call. Leave empty for the first page.

search_documents.afterResponse:

return { documents, count: documents.length, nextPageToken: response.nextPageToken ?? null };

copy_document.label: Copy Document

title.label: New Document Title

parents.label: Folder
parents.description: Leave empty to include all of Drive.

copy_document.afterResponse: return { id: response.id ?? '', name: response.name ?? '', webViewLink: response.webViewLink ?? '', parents: response.parents ?? [] };

get_document_end_index.label: Get Document End Index

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: The ID of the document to inspect (from the document URL or Search Documents).

const content = response.body?.content ?? [], endIndex = content[content.length - 1]?.endIndex ?? 1;
return { documentId: inputs.documentId, title: response.title ?? null, endIndex, maxInsertIndex: Math.max(1, endIndex - 1) };

insert_text.afterResponse:
